basics-first.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make a production frame sheet for a 2D game by drawing the exact yellow amphibian in the uploaded reference in eight specified poses. The reference is the drawing of the actual character; don't substitute a generic cartoon frog. Preserve the silhouette from that one drawing across the movement like rotating and bending the same drawn puppet: unusually long and broad smoothly rounded head, long curved cervical back that merges uninterrupted into the shoulder (no round separate head bead), subtly rounded blunt muzzle and delicate short horizontal mouth, cream lip wedge as in the reference, same round olive eyes, taupe mitt-like three-finger hands and long tapered taupe toes. The large, deeply projecting lower belly is by far the widest part and takes most of the torso, with a broad cream patch reaching both sides and lying distinctly below the shoulders. It stays very full even when he crouches or tucks his knees. Preserve elongated forearms and long two-section legs with distinct knees and ankles; folded legs take a pronounced zigzag and hind limbs show their full reach when extended. Hands, feet and color matches from the input. Copy the actual hand-drawn irregular warm-brown ink, light hand-painted shading, amber yellow and matte ivory from the reference. One and the same mature-proportioned funny frog every time, no round mini head, short chibi limbs, thin belly, sharp beak, broad smile, or human segmentation of the head or neck.

Exact beautiful wide 2:1 transparent PNG atlas, four columns by two rows, strict equal cells with ample gutters and readable contour, full hands and feet within each cell. All face screen right in the same view as the master. Use this order:
TOP 1 low preparatory squat with knees sharply folded out, soles planted, elbows folded and both hands in fists. The full belly reaches down between the feet and long head/neck still projects upward in the exact shape of the reference.
TOP 2 strong rise and takeoff, extended rear leg reaching down-left with toes on ground, front leg bent, front hand held up in fist, other hand swept rearward beside flank with elbow visible; long torso angled up-right.
TOP 3 airborne on the way upward, both feet curled under bent knees, fists near the chest, upper body upright and the same long head silhouette.
TOP 4 apex airborne, both knees gently bent forwards and underneath, both open palms extended outward for balance, the belly drawn forward prominently.
BOTTOM 1 descent in the air, opened palms outwards, two long lower legs clearly extending down compared with TOP 4, feet separated.
BOTTOM 2 low compressed landing with soles flat, knees bent out, arms reaching forward with relaxed open palms, keep the same large round abdomen and long head.
BOTTOM 3 regaining the regular guard stance, both fists held and legs still lightly bent outward; anatomically almost the reference standing pose.
BOTTOM 4 forward dash as a long low diagonal, head and body leaning to right, both fists swept behind along streamlined long arms, one long rear leg straight and the nearer leg folded deep beneath the belly.

True RGBA empty background (including between arms and abdomen), opaque paint on the actor, clean subtle antialias on outlines. No text, lines, labels, ornaments, extra limbs, speed marks, motion lines, glow, ground, shadows, or pixelation. Each cell has only that pose, all eight distinct and faithful.

basics-second.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite art drawing eight keyframes of the single exact character from Image 1. Copy the actual chosen character shape, not a reinterpretation. Treat the uploaded reference as a rigid anatomical puppet which you pose or lean. The frog has a distinct elongated and broad smooth-skull upper outline extending continuously into a long neck-to-shoulder curve with no separate sphere or constricted neck, a little rounded blunt snout with its original short horizontal dark mouth trace and light soft lip, familiar round olive eyes with dark pupils, rich yellow skin, dark taupe three-finger paws and three-toed webbed feet. The long top section stays long even when bending, tilting or sideways; rotate its whole silhouette with its neck. Keep a huge wide low-bulging belly, visible as a well-rounded shape even when he folds, sits or gets pushed back. The belly is dominant and cream, natural legs and arms are quite long and visibly jointed with distinct forearms and shins even when folded. Preserve the same head and eye proportions and accent coloring. Use the exact chosen drawing's warm dark brown varied ink, clear hand-rendered shape, clean rich golden and pale cream matte painted fill with fine grain. Every pose ordinary, with all original anatomical details. No wing, halo, costume, tail, effects, drops, clothing or accessories.

Strict equal 4 columns × 2 rows, landscape 2:1, transparent atlas. Leave generous truly transparent gutters around all four edges of each tile. Show whole actor in each of the 8 cells from head to all visible feet, same visual scale for matched poses. Opaque body, transparent background and between limbs, anticontoured crisp edges, no backdrop/shadow/color spill/pixel art/text/staging marks. Pose order is the order below; the descriptions are keyframes from the animator.
Top row left to right, all generally face right: (1) light hit recoil, drawing the long head upward and backward slightly, frowning subtly, both fists pulled up near the chest, long legs flexed and soles still planted. (2) heavier hit, long head tilted down close to huge belly, tightly closed eye and extremely brief small grimace, both hands press belly, knees flexed and feet wide apart; the head is elongated across the diagonal between crown and mouth. (3) airborne knockback, leaned back, head tilted up with rounded screaming open mouth, both arms wide spread with open hands and both long bent legs rising forward, toes visible; use the correct long head as a tilted shape. (4) backward rolling midair curled pose, both long knees sharply bent up, both fists tucked near chest, crying grimace and eyes compressed, upper body tilted back and rotated, full bulging abdomen inside curled limbs. 
Bottom row left to right: (5) fallen on side, completely horizontal body, long head lies to the left on its side and eyes shut, arms softly curled near belly and body touches the ground, longer legs extend on the ground to the right. The silhouette of the head remains like a long wide lozenge from rear to little mouth, visibly using the rotated canonical form, never a ball. (6) getting up, down on one knee, supports body with one long arm whose palm is on ground, other arm bent over raised knee, still long oval head inclined toward the right, belly present. (7) half-standing after rising, knees bent and angled, soles grounded, both forearms bent, upper long head inclines forward facing right, lower abdomen stays large, trying to regain balance. (8) guard-breaking stagger with one foot out toward the right, long head leaning back, mouth open, both arms spread wide at different heights and lower swollen belly pushing forward. Avoid an identical body pose in (3) and (8), airborne knees versus wide stepping legs.

scenes-first.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Redraw the exact ordinary golden frog in the sole uploaded reference, to match his ORIGINAL four animated entrance poses. Maintain his notably long broad rounded head and continuous smooth curve from crown/neck down to shoulder, distinctive round olive eyes, tiny blunt muzzle and short dark horizontal lips, long limbs and extremely full ivory belly. Same human hand-drawn image style, soft clean brown lines and warm matte gold painter color, taupe hands/feet. True transparent RGBA and opaque character.

Four equally wide separate square cells in ONE wide horizontal row, no background, no marks, no shadow. Use these four precise keyframes. Pose 1: clearly LYING on the ground sideways, body and shoulders quite low and reclining diagonally, head faces camera and is placed in the right half. The near bent arm and forearm run ALONG THE GROUND HORIZONTALLY from shoulder toward his central hip; its palm rests near belly/hip, precisely not planted out to the right. Other hand on forehead with its elbow high. A long top leg extends diagonally up-left; bottom leg still bent with left foot flat on the imaginary ground. Pose 2: exact same head and both arms with low shoulders planted on the same spot. Slowly lower raised long leg to horizontal pointing left, the lower bent leg still planted. Pose 3: same character sits up, head is on the screen-right half of his body but nose and eyes FACE SCREEN LEFT in a three-quarter view, both knees and feet grouped to SCREEN LEFT, one hand supports on ground on the far SCREEN RIGHT and the opposite palm rests on the raised knee toward screen left. Pose 4: rises into deep planted squat now facing viewer, one hand still touching forehead, other tilted diagonally toward front ground between his planted long wide-folded legs. Same very long-rounded head, knuckles, toes and very large ivory abdomen beyond the legs. Keep all four poses anatomically the same frog in the uploaded image, distinctly longer head and hands/feet. Preserve full silhouette with huge transparent gutter in every cell, no overlapping limbs between cells, no writing, numbers, lines, a ground sign or extra objects.
